title: Prepare a statement of cash flows using the cash T-account approach

items.concept: Reconstruct entries from comparative BS and IS; subsequent measurement schedules; period-end depreciation AJE (noncash emphasis); complete cash T-account; direct-method SCF
Number-variant twin — subsequent measurement schedules, reconstructed entries (including period-end dep AJE), cash T-account, and direct-method SCF (gain on disposal + note principal repayment)
Period-end depreciation AJE and year-end salary accrual AJE (noncash); PPE disposal JE; bond maturity settlement JE; map only cash legs into O/I/F sections of the cash T-account
Classification — which reconstructed items appear in the cash T-account; treatment of period-end depreciation AJE and restricted cash in the SCF reconciliation
